subject: Tata Sierra vs Hyundai Creta
_angle: OPT2 · Power play — lead with the 160-vs-115 power gap as the hero contrast; Sierra-leaning, calm delivery

segments.text: Same money — but the Sierra's turbo makes a hundred-sixty horses to the Creta's hundred-fifteen.
One-sixty turbo versus one-fifteen — the Sierra simply pulls harder, no contest.
The Creta's trump card? It starts a little cheaper, and it's the proven, resale-friendly favourite.
For the money, though, the Sierra feels like a lot more car. Smash like if power wins.
So — Sierra or Creta? Comment one or two. Like, share, and subscribe.
